title: Plan OD-10/R1006: every subcommand flag is reachable from the CLI
body:
Plan for **OD-10**/`R1006`, written by the steward worker the unattended delivery driver dispatched on base `run/web`. Slug `subcommand-flag-forwarding`, `covers: [R1006]`, 309 lines.

Every subcommand flag must be reachable from the CLI — a flag the code accepts but the parser never forwards is a capability that exists and cannot be used.

One **LOW** uncertainty is filed in `docs/BACKLOG.md` in this same commit; the plan proceeds on its recorded default and the oracle reviews it next cycle, per AGENTS.md.

Opened by the server-side `open-pr` workflow at the driver's request (ESC-50).
